title: Show CSV rerun topbar pending status
summary: Show a pending CSV rerun command in the top bar immediately after operator confirmation, before the next backend event arrives.
reason: Live CSV rerun can leave the top bar showing stale idle/None snapshot text while the backend is starting work.
behavior_before: CSV rerun start updated the Launch tab status but did not set a top-bar pending command, so stale snapshot activity could remain visible.
behavior_after: CSV rerun start sets a labeled pending top-bar activity and ticker, keeps it across stale snapshot refreshes, and clears it for dry-run/plan-only completion or failures.
